item.title: Wilson Lin on FastRender: a browser built by parallel agents
item.description:
📝 01:57 As that experiment progressed, I was seeing better and better results from single agents that were able to actually make good progress on this project. Running thousands of agents at once The most interesting thing about FastRender is the way the project used multiple agents working in parallel to build different parts of the browser. The agents are arranged in a tree structure, with planning agents firing up tasks and worker agents then carrying them out.
🔗 Read more: https://simonwillison.net/2026/Jan/23/fastrender/
